title: Volcanoes of Oceania (hard)
intro: 10 volcanoes of Oceania, one after another. Put your marker as near as you can; the nearer, the more points. Only the coasts are drawn and the full-points circle is small, so this is the hard version.

rounds.name: Sulu Range
rounds.fact: Sulu Range is a volcano with a recorded summit elevation of 556 m in the source data. The data places it in Papua New Guinea.

rounds.name: Unnamed
rounds.fact: Unnamed is a submarine volcano; the latest significant eruption recorded for it in the source data was in 1907. The data places it in Tonga.
